## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Market-neutral copula-based pairs trading on ten Binance USDT perpetuals (hourly, Jan 2021 to Dec 2023) produced negative net returns at a baseline cost of 0.08% per round trip, with drawdowns under 20%; the version with directional overlay only tracked buy-and-hold. (low confidence) — https://www.aimspress.com/article/doi/10.3934/QFE.2026016
